lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance spots is observed posterior to the gill slits; spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-flank, with wider spacing observed towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear gradients of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a visible matrix-like lattice structure on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge runs across the mid-upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a bright dorsal-facing edge and a dark shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the anterior and basal regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, linear trailing feature is visible attached to the ventral margin of the lower caudal lobe, extending into the water column.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark silhouettes consistent with commensal fish (remoras) are visible near the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fins.
